response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience and strong fundamentals in testing and distributed systems, his resume lacks the critical domain expertise required for this Principal-level role. Specifically, there is no evidence of experience architecting large-scale growth, experimentation, or telemetry platforms, which are the core responsibilities of this position.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains, including high-throughput microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Strong commitment to engineering excellence, demonstrated by building test frameworks, driving TDD practices, and organizing technical workshops.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling, aligning well with the AI-first focus of the role.
concerns: Lacks demonstrated experience designing and building enterprise-scale experimentation frameworks, A/B testing platforms, or telemetry systems.
Missing required background in data analysis, statistical methods, and experimentation quality (bias detection, rollout-risk management).
Most recent roles have been at the Senior or Staff level, which may not translate to the enterprise-wide cross-team influence expected of a Principal (IC6) engineer.
